senses.gloss: (v. בָּעָה; cmp. בהל) to be excited.—Af. אַבַּע to hurry.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 22:9">Targ. I Kings XXII, 9</cite> <he>א׳ מיכיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>תבע</he>, h. text <cite ref="M00382"><he>מהרה</he></cite>) bring … quickly.
Targ. Ezek. XXIV, 5.—Part. pass. מַבַּע, (מִבְ׳) מַבְּעָא quick.

senses.gloss: to be in a hurry, be anxious.
